papers.ablations: Feature-only JPEG average 70.7; prediction-only 72.9; both 71.1 in the extracted ablation. Adding a +1.4M-parameter frequency branch reduced JPEG average to 57.6 and was interpreted as overfitting.

papers.codeStatus: No authoritative public implementation was located during this audit.
papers.weightsStatus: No public deployment checkpoint was located during this audit.

crossPaperConclusion.publishedEvidence: The primary literature supports three distinct strategies: control dataset/codec shortcuts, use phase/global/semantic complementary cues, and train with paired degraded views.
crossPaperConclusion.lythausEvidence: R1 independently measured that SAFE-A collapses on actual JPEG descendants, that Seedream-4/Imagen-4 embeddings lie near real controls, and that current scalar phase/DCT cues are descriptive but not yet a validated rescue specialist.
crossPaperConclusion.inference: The highest-value next experiment is a small Lythaus-owned compression/eligibility specialist qualification, with SAFE-A retained frozen. A SAFE-B head is not justified by the current frozen representation.
crossPaperConclusion.rightsAndRuntime: No new neural paper method is deployment-cleared by this ledger; code, weights, foundation models and datasets remain separate gates.
